facts.text: The resort has private bungalows set on five acres atop the bluffs above Santa Monica's beaches.
facts.excerpt: private bungalows nestled upon five lush acres atop the bluffs of Los Angeles's golden beaches

facts.text: The resort was born from a grand 19th-century estate.

facts.text: A large Moreton Bay Fig tree at the entrance predates the 100-year-old property.

facts.text: Top-floor suites in the Ocean Tower have two furnished balconies overlooking the beach.
